messages:
Rina (FinOps): Nemora Labs flagged INV-2026-076: shows reserved hours plus an overage for 2026-03-05 03:00-04:30 UTC. Says this is duplicate billing.
Luis (Acct Mgr): They attached screenshot. reserved=120h, shared=18h, total=138h. They claim failover should have used their reserved fallback.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-076 posted. reserved_hours=120, shared_hours=18, shared_charge=$3,564.
Marta (Customer Success): Nemora says failover was scheduled and pods came up in europe-north; they didn't intentionally use shared.
Theo (SRE): Quick logs show failover triggered 03:12 UTC. Pod recreation used nodeSelector region=europe-north but some nodes lacked label pool=nemora-dedicated-eu. Meter shows events for both nemora-dedicated-eu and nemora-shared-eu. Could be vendor duplicated meter events.
Rina (FinOps): If vendor duplicated meter events we reverse; otherwise customer pays. Need pod_id-level meter dump from vendor.
Luis (Acct Mgr): Opening vendor request VND-4608 now for CSV with pod_id,node_id,meter_type,timestamp. Also propose provisional credit to reduce churn.
billing-bot: VND-4608 created. FIN-3419 created for provisional credit workflow.
Marta (Customer Success): Nemora requests provisional adjustment while vendor audits. They'll run a failover test with SRE.
Rina (FinOps): Approve provisional hold up to $2,500 pending vendor audit and successful failover test within 72h. If vendor confirms duplication, reverse fully. If not, apply goodwill up to $2.5k and bill remainder.
Theo (SRE): I'll export pod lifecycle IDs and share with vendor; adding pipeline check to assert fallback pool labels present.
Luis (Acct Mgr): I'll send provisional-ack form to Nemora and chase vendor for CSV. Will update thread when vendor responds.
Rina (FinOps): Noted. FIN-3419 will track outcome; Luis to update by vendor ETA.
